shortDescription: Radar Renegade A/T-5 245/70R16 – confident all-terrain performance. The Renegade A/T-5 is a dependable all-terrain performer built for 4x4s and bakkies that need one tyre to handle the daily commute,…
description:
Radar Renegade A/T-5 245/70R16 – confident all-terrain performance
The Radar Renegade A/T-5 in 245/70R16 is a all-terrain 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want reliable traction on tar, gravel and dirt with the strength for work and play. The Renegade A/T-5 is a dependable all-terrain performer built for 4x4s and bakkies that need one tyre to handle the daily commute, the gravel road and the worksite.

This 245/70R16 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Proven all-terrain pattern – Staggered tread blocks and wide grooves deliver traction on tar, gravel, dirt and light mud.
Open shoulder with stone ejectors – Clears stones and mud to keep the tread biting and protect the casing.
Cut- and chip-resistant compound – A temperature-adaptive compound holds grip and resists damage in tough conditions.
Reinforced construction – Load-carrying strength for SUVs and bakkies with added puncture resistance.
Comfort-tuned tread – Variable-pitch geometry helps keep road noise low for a comfortable highway ride.
Balanced on/off-road ability – A hard-working all-rounder for drivers who mix sealed and unsealed roads.

Suitable vehicles
TOYOTA HILUX

FORD RANGER

ISUZU D-MAX

Buy the Radar Renegade A/T-5 245/70R16 online at The Tyre Mall – browse the full Radar Renegade 4x4 tyre range and find the right fitment for your bakkie, SUV or 4x4.

With P Zero Trofeo R you can fully appreciate the performance of extreme vehicles in complete safety, especially on the track. In extreme conditions, typical of racetrack driving, it reacts with precision to commands. On dry asphalt, even in the most demanding sessions it ensures high levels of grip and constant trajectories. P Zero Trofeo R is not recommended for use in very wet track conditions. Specific for racetrack driving, it is approved for road use, enabling travel to the track. In the event of very wet asphalt, with the risk of aquaplaning, prudent driving at reduced speed is recommended. P Zero Trofeo R has brand new HAOF (highly aromatic oil free) compounds and a redesigned tread pattern that have produced extraordinary results: on the one hand, a notable improvement in stability and, above all lateral grip in the dry, on the other hand, a reduction in wear of up to 80%.

description:
Continental Sport Contact 5 255/35R18 94Y XL MO – Ultimate High-Performance Control
Unleash the full potential of your sport sedan or high-performance coupe with the Continental Sport Contact 5 255/35R18 94Y XL MO. Engineered for drivers who demand absolute precision, this premium ultra-high-performance (UHP) tyre delivers exceptional cornering grip, short stopping distances, and sports-level handling under any road conditions.

This specific fitment carries the prestigious MO (Mercedes Original) designation, meaning it was custom-engineered in partnership with Mercedes-Benz to match the exact performance characteristics of their premium vehicles, though it serves as an exceptional upgrade for any performance car requiring this size.

Key Features & Benefits:

BlackChili Compound for Maximum Grip: Continental’s innovative tread racing compound adapts to the roughness of the road surface, ensuring optimal transmission of power and shorter braking distances in both wet and dry conditions.

Extra Load (XL) Rating: Built with a reinforced carcass to handle higher load capacities and cornering forces, ensuring the tyre maintains its structural shape and sharp steering response during spirited driving.

94Y Speed & Performance: Rated safely for high-speed sports performance up to 300 km/h, delivering unmatched stability on the highway and through tight bends.

Reduced Rolling Resistance: Despite its aggressive grip, the advanced compounding helps lower rolling resistance, improving fuel efficiency and increasing tread mileage compared to standard sports tyres.

- Tougher Sidewalls: CoreGuard Max Technology ensures 27% tougher sidewalls, protecting against sharp objects and sidewall splitting.

- Versatile Performance: The Linear Flex Zone allows the tire to flex and envelop objects in aired-down situations, boosting off-road capabilities.

This tire is built for durability, traction, and versatility, making it a reliable choice for conquering challenging terrains.

Reinforced Commercial Construction: Engineered with an extra-strong carcass and robust sidewalls to resist punctures, cuts, and curb impacts during demanding urban and regional delivery routes.

Engineered for Extended Mileage: Formulated with an advanced, wear-resistant rubber compound that promotes uniform tread wear, keeping your vehicles on the road longer between replacements.

description:
Continental Sport Contact 5 225/45R17 91Y MO – Precision Handling & Sports Performance
Transform your daily drive with the Continental Sport Contact 5 225/45R17 91Y MO. As one of the most trusted ultra-high-performance (UHP) tyres on the market, this fitment is engineered for drivers who refuse to compromise on steering precision, cornering stability, and short stopping distances.

This specific model features the prestigious MO (Mercedes Original) stamp of approval, signifying that it has been custom-tailored to meet the rigorous safety and performance standards of Mercedes-Benz vehicles—making it a perfect factory replacement or an exceptional high-tier upgrade for any passenger car using this popular 17-inch size.

Key Features & Benefits:

Shortest Braking Distances: Utilizing Continental's signature BlackChili compound, the tread reacts to braking friction by heating up, delivering maximum surface adhesion and significantly shorter stopping distances in both wet and dry conditions.

High-Speed Stability (91Y): Rated for speeds up to 300 km/h, this tyre offers flawless stability on the highway, ensuring a firm, secure connection to the road when cornering hard.

Unmatched Cornering Grip: The macro-block design of the outer shoulder adapts to the road surface, providing an extended contact area for maximum grip and precise steering feedback through tight bends.

Fuel Efficient Sport Performance: The advanced tyre construction minimizes rolling resistance during normal driving, helping you reduce fuel consumption and extend overall tread life without sacrificing sports performance.

name: PIRELLI 235/45ZR17 PZERO R ASIM
shortDescription: Passenger Tyres , UHP , SUV Tyres
description: Developed to provide even greater performance - on the occasion of Track Days - when fitted to the most powerful vehicles such as Porsche, Ferrari, BMW, Lamborghini, including the MY2012. With P Zero Trofeo R you can fully appreciate the performance of extreme vehicles in complete safety, especially on the track. In extreme conditions, typical of racetrack driving, it reacts with precision to commands. On dry asphalt, even in the most demanding sessions it ensures high levels of grip and constant trajectories. P Zero Trofeo R is not recommended for use in very wet track conditions. Specific for racetrack driving, it is approved for road use, enabling travel to the track. In the event of very wet asphalt, with the risk of aquaplaning, prudent driving at reduced speed is recommended. P Zero Trofeo R has brand new HAOF (highly aromatic oil free) compounds and a redesigned tread pattern that have produced extraordinary results: on the one hand, a notable improvement in stability and, above all lateral grip in the dry, on the other hand, a reduction in wear of up to 80%.

Radar Renegade M/T-R7 235/85R16 120/116Q – maximum mud-terrain traction
The Radar Renegade M/T-R7 in 235/85R16 120/116Q is a mud-terrain (M/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want extreme off-road grip when the terrain turns serious. The Renegade M/T-R7 is a full mud-terrain tyre for drivers who take the rough route — deep mud, rock, clay and loose ground — and want maximum traction and durability.

This 235/85R16 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

High-void mud-terrain tread – Aggressive, widely spaced lugs bite hard in mud, rock and loose terrain.
Deep shoulder and side lugs – Extra bite at the shoulders plus sidewall protection in the toughest conditions.
Self-cleaning design – Ejects mud and stones as the tyre turns so the tread keeps gripping.
Reinforced sidewall and casing – Built to resist cuts and punctures on harsh off-road tracks.
Rugged construction – Suited to lifted and big-foot 4x4 builds.
Extreme off-road capability – Serious traction for the trail, with road manners you can live with.

Radar Renegade A/T-5 255/70R16 – confident all-terrain performance

The Renegade A/T-5 is a dependable all-terrain performer built for 4x4s and bakkies that need one tyre to handle the daily commute, the gravel road and the worksite.

This 255/70R16 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Proven all-terrain pattern – Staggered tread blocks and wide grooves deliver traction on tar, gravel, dirt and light mud.
Open shoulder with stone ejectors – Clears stones and mud to keep the tread biting and protect the casing.

description:
Radar Renegade R/T+ 265/70R18 121/118Q – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners
The Radar Renegade R/T+ in 265/70R18 121/118Q is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week.

This 265/70R18 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar.
Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground.
Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear.
Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection.
Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips.
Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.

Suitable vehicles
TOYOTA HILUX

FORD RANGER

VW AMAROK

Refined Sport Comfort: Features optimized pitch sequencing and fine siping that breaks up harmonic road frequencies, providing a surprisingly quiet and smooth cabin ride for a low-profile UHP sport tire.

description:
Radar Renegade R/T+ 265/65R18 117/114Q – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners
The Radar Renegade R/T+ in 265/65R18 117/114Q is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week.

This 265/65R18 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar.
Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground.
Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear.
Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection.
Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips.
Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.

Suitable vehicles
TOYOTA HILUX LEGEND

shortDescription: Passenger Tyres , UHP , SUV Tyres
description:
Unlock sharp handling, sporty performance, and incredible value with the Timax Eco Sport 59 225/45R17 94W XL. Engineered specifically for modern hatchbacks, sport compacts, and executive passenger sedans, this low-profile, Ultra-High-Performance (UHP) tire delivers an engaging, responsive driving experience without the premium price tag.

The Eco Sport 59 features an asymmetric tread design that balances high-speed stability with dependable everyday safety. With its extra-load (XL) reinforcement, this tire offers excellent lateral stability, keeping your vehicle planted through sharp corners and long highway stretches alike. It’s the ideal upgrade for drivers wanting an aggressive look and crisp road feedback on their daily commute.

Key Benefits & Features

Asymmetric Sport Performance: Built with distinct inner and outer tread zones. The rigid outer shoulder elements lock down maximum rubber-to-road contact for confident cornering, while the interior tread works to keep the ride stable.

Extra Load (XL) Durability: Upgraded with a reinforced XL carcass and a 94 load index (up to 670 kg per tire), giving the sidewalls enhanced structural rigidity to resist flexing and ensure crisp vehicle balance under load.

W-Rated High-Speed Engineering: Fully certified with a W speed rating (up to 270 km/h), ensuring the tire disperses heat efficiently, runs cool under friction, and retains total structural tracking integrity at highway speeds.

Reliable Wet Weather Protection: Four wide longitudinal water grooves rapidly clear rain from beneath the tire footprint, dramatically reducing stopping distances and protecting against hydroplaning on slick asphalt.

Precise Steering Feedback: A solid, continuous center rib ensures constant asphalt connection, offering the driver instant steering wheel responsiveness and reliable straight-line tracking.

The Radar Renegade R/T+ in is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week.

This fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar.
Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground.
Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear.
Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection.
Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips.
Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.

description:
Radar Renegade A/T-5 – confident all-terrain performance
The Radar Renegade A/T-5 in is a all-terrain 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want reliable traction on tar, gravel and dirt with the strength for work and play. The Renegade A/T-5 is a dependable all-terrain performer built for 4x4s and bakkies that need one tyre to handle the daily commute, the gravel road and the worksite.

This fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Proven all-terrain pattern – Staggered tread blocks and wide grooves deliver traction on tar, gravel, dirt and light mud.
Open shoulder with stone ejectors – Clears stones and mud to keep the tread biting and protect the casing.
Cut- and chip-resistant compound – A temperature-adaptive compound holds grip and resists damage in tough conditions.
Reinforced construction – Load-carrying strength for SUVs and bakkies with added puncture resistance.
Comfort-tuned tread – Variable-pitch geometry helps keep road noise low for a comfortable highway ride.
Balanced on/off-road ability – A hard-working all-rounder for drivers who mix sealed and unsealed roads.

name: LANDSAIL 215/35WR19 LANDSAIL LS588 UHP 85 XL
shortDescription: Transform your vehicle's stance and handling with the ultra-low profile Landsail LS588 UHP 215/35WR19 85W XL. Engineered specifically for sports compacts, tuned sedans, and custom wheel upgrades that…
description:
Transform your vehicle's stance and handling with the ultra-low profile Landsail LS588 UHP 215/35WR19 85W XL. Engineered specifically for sports compacts, tuned sedans, and custom wheel upgrades that demand an aggressive, painted-on look, this Ultra-High-Performance (UHP) tire delivers precise cornering response without compromising on ride refinement.

The LS588 UHP features an advanced asymmetric tread profile designed to maximize the rubber's contact area during intense lateral cornering. Backed by Extra Load (XL) reinforcement, it provides the necessary structural stiffness to protect your premium rims from road imperfections while delivering the high-speed thermal stability needed for confident highway driving.

Key Benefits & Features

Ultra-Low Profile Performance: The 35-series profile gives your car a stunning, aggressive stance and drastically reduces sidewall flex for instantaneous, razor-sharp steering feedback.

Extra Load (XL) Construction: Reinforced with an XL rating and an 85 load index (up to 515 kg per tire), offering a tougher internal carcass that better handles high performance pressures and helps shield rims against harsh impacts.

W-Rated High-Speed Confidence: Fully certified with a W speed rating (up to 270 km/h), ensuring the tread pattern runs cool, dissipates heat efficiently, and retains total tracking integrity at high velocities.

Advanced Asymmetric Grip: Features independent tread zones—the solid outer block shoulder locks down heavy traction during hard cornering, while the optimized inner tread quickly flushes water away.

Optimized Quiet Cruise: Even with its low-profile sports design, the variable-pitch tread alignment helps break up harmonic air patterns to keep annoying road roar at bay during everyday highway commuting.

description:
The LS588 UHP is an all-season ultra-high-performance tire designed by Landsail. Here are the key features and specifications:

Performance and Fitment:

Speed Ratings: V, W, and Y (suitable for high-performance automobiles)
Fitment: Multiple staggered fitments make this the UHP tire of choice.
Ultra-High-Performance Handling: The long grooves and lateral grooves work together to provide excellent traction during cornering.
Smooth and Quiet Ride: Optimum tread pitch width and alignment minimize road noise.
Excellent Dry Handling: A large tread contact area ensures optimized grip and control on dry, hot surfaces.
Wet Traction: Specific groove placement reduces hydroplaning risk by channeling water away from the tire surface.
Unique “LS” Silica Compound: This specialty formulated compound enhances flexibility in low temperatures, improves wet traction, and reduces rolling resistance for better fuel efficiency.

LS Silica Compound:

The LS588 UHP is equipped with Landsail’s LS Silica Compound, ensuring true ultra-high performance without sacrificing comfort, ride quality, or reliability.

For more information and to find this tire, you can visit the Landsail LS588 UHP product page

name: LANDSAIL 235/35ZR19 LANDSAIL LS588 91W
shortDescription: Passenger Tyres , UHP , SUV Tyres
description:
Experience an exceptional blend of sharp, high-speed handling and everyday driving comfort with the Landsail LS588 UHP 235/35ZR19 91W. Tailored specifically for modern sports sedans, executive performance cars, and premium coupes requiring a low-profile fitment, this Ultra-High-Performance (UHP) tire proves you don't have to sacrifice a smooth ride to get dynamic track-like responsiveness.

The LS588 UHP utilizes an advanced, computer-optimized asymmetric tread compound that maximizes asphalt contact during spirited cornering and rapid highway cruising. Engineered with an specialized silica formulation to keep rolling resistance low while drastically boosting wet grip, this tire delivers the crisp steering feedback and braking control necessary to confidently harness your vehicle’s power.

Key Benefits & Features

Asymmetric All-Weather Tread: Engineered with specialized inner and outer tread zones. The rigid outer shoulder blocks provide exceptional bite during heavy cornering, while the interior tread blocks are optimized to sweep road water away.

Advanced Silica Compound: Built with a high-tech silica formulation that minimizes rolling resistance for better fuel economy, while simultaneously improving flexibility for superior grip on slick, rain-soaked asphalt.

High-Speed W-Rating: Fully certified with a W speed rating (up to 270 km/h), ensuring the carcass runs cool under friction and retains absolute structural integrity during high-velocity highway travel.

Quiet Comfort Technology: Optimized pitch alignment along the tread block sequence works to actively break up rhythmic tire noise, offering a remarkably quiet, vibration-free cabin environment for a low-profile UHP profile.

Superior Hydroplaning Resistance: Four wide, continuous longitudinal grooves rapidly funnel surface water away from the center contact patch, maximizing traction and reducing stopping distances in heavy downpours.

description:
The Perfect Balance of Comfort, Performance, and Everyday Value
Upgrade your ride with the Landsail CLV2 (265/65R17 112H), a premium-quality, high-performance SUV tyre designed for drivers who want exceptional on-road reliability without the premium price tag. Engineered specifically for modern SUVs, crossovers, and everyday urban bakkies, the CLV2 delivers a smooth, quiet, and stable ride across all seasons.

Whether you're tackling the daily city commute, school runs, or long highway road trips, this tyre is built to handle the weight of larger vehicles while maximizing fuel efficiency and tread life.

Key Features & Benefits:

Enhanced Wet Weather Safety: Four wide longitudinal grooves efficiently channel water away from the tread, drastically reducing the risk of aquaplaning and ensuring excellent wet-braking performance.

Quiet & Comfortable Ride: The optimized pitch design and closed shoulder blocks isolate road vibration, keeping cabin noise to an absolute minimum for a premium highway driving experience.

Stable High-Speed Handling: The solid center rib enhances directional stability and steering responsiveness, giving you total control on the highway at higher speeds (H-rated up to 210 km/h).

All-Season Grip: An advanced silica tread compound combined with micro-sipes delivers dependable traction on both dry and wet South African roads.

Excellent Value for Money: Offers a highly competitive cost-per-kilometer, making it an incredibly smart choice for budget-conscious drivers who refuse to compromise on safety.

Ideal Fitment: A perfect, wallet-friendly match for popular SUVs and bakkies requiring a 265/65R17 tyre size (including the Toyota Hilux, Fortuner, Ford Ranger, Isuzu D-Max, and Mitsubishi Pajero). Order online today and get professional installation handled seamlessly by our network of Tyre Fitment Partners!

name: LANDSAIL 265/60VR18 LANDSAIL LS588 110
shortDescription: Upgrade your driving experience with the Landsail LS588 SUV 265/60VR18 110V, a premium high-performance touring tire engineered specifically for modern luxury SUVs, large crossovers, and…
description:
Upgrade your driving experience with the Landsail LS588 SUV 265/60VR18 110V, a premium high-performance touring tire engineered specifically for modern luxury SUVs, large crossovers, and highway-driven double-cab bakkies. Designed for drivers who prioritize tarmac comfort, sharp handling, and high-speed safety, this tire bridges the gap between rugged utility and refined passenger car smoothness.

The LS588 SUV features an advanced, computer-optimized asymmetric tread design that maximizes your vehicle's footprint on the road. Whether you are navigating tight highway bends or handling sudden stops in a torrential downpour, the advanced silica-rich compound ensures unyielding grip. Built to handle the higher center of gravity and weight of modern SUVs, it delivers a whisper-quiet cabin experience alongside the heavy-load durability your vehicle demands.

Key Benefits & Features

Asymmetric SUV Handling: Built with distinct inner and outer tread zones. The rigid outer shoulder blocks lock down maximum stability to prevent body roll during high-speed cornering, while the interior blocks optimize everyday ride comfort.

Heavy-Duty Load Capacity: Engineered with a robust 110 load index, allowing each tire to safely support up to 1,060 kg. This makes it an ideal choice for larger family SUVs and utility vehicles carrying full passenger loads or towing.

Advanced Fuel-Saving Silica: The high-tech silica tread compound is formulated to significantly reduce rolling resistance. This keeps your engine running more efficiently, cutting down on fuel consumption and extending overall tread life.

Whisper-Quiet Pitch Alignment: Landsail’s specialized pitch optimization breaks up harmonic air frequencies within the tread grooves, keeping irritating highway road roar out of your SUV’s cabin.

Elite Wet-Weather Drainage: Four wide, continuous longitudinal channels rapidly expel surface water from beneath the tire footprint, dramatically shortening wet braking distances and minimizing the risk of hydroplaning.

shortDescription: Radar Renegade R/T+ 265/70R17 121/118Q – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners. Part of Radar’s Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best…
description:
Radar Renegade R/T+ 265/70R17 121/118Q – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners
The Radar Renegade R/T+ in 265/70R17 121/118Q is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week.

This 265/70R17 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar.
Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground.
Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear.
Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection.
Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips.
Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.

Suitable vehicles
TOYOTA HILUX

FORD RANGER

TOYOTA FORTUNER

JEEP WRANGLER

name: WINDFORCE 265/65R17 112T RWL CATCHFORS A/T
shortDescription: Passenger Tyres
description:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety.

The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire.

The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing.

The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: WINDFORCE 255/70R16 111S XL OWL CATCHFORS A/T
shortDescription:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the…
description:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety.

The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire.

The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing.

The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing.

The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: WINDFORCE 265/65R17 112T RWL CATCHFORS A/T II
shortDescription:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the…
description:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety.

The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire.

The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing.

The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

shortDescription:

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the…
description:
The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks.

The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety.

The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire.

The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing.

The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: TRACMAX 215/45R17 X PRIVILO TX3
shortDescription: Bring a sporty edge, sharp handling, and excellent street performance to your everyday drive with the Tracmax X-Privilo TX3 215/45R17 91W XL. Engineered specifically for modern hatchbacks, sportier…
description:
Bring a sporty edge, sharp handling, and excellent street performance to your everyday drive with the Tracmax X-Privilo TX3 215/45R17 91W XL. Engineered specifically for modern hatchbacks, sportier compact sedans, and custom street setups, this low-profile Ultra-High-Performance (UHP) tire delivers precise handling and high-speed confidence at an incredible value.

The X-Privilo TX3 features an advanced asymmetric tread profile designed to maximize the rubber's contact area during spirited cornering and rapid highway cruising. Backed by Extra Load (XL) reinforcement, it gives the sidewalls the necessary structural stiffness to eliminate sluggish tire flex, providing crisp steering wheel response while maintaining a sleek, aggressive stance on your rims.

Key Benefits & Features

Asymmetric Sport Handling: Designed with dedicated inner and outer tread zones. The rigid outer shoulder elements lock down maximum cornering traction to combat body roll, while the interior tread pattern focuses on straight-line tracking.

Extra Load (XL) Protection: Upgraded with a reinforced XL carcass and a 91 load index (up to 615 kg per tire), offering increased internal rigidity that improves vehicle balance under stress and helps shield your rims against sudden road imperfections.

W-Rated High-Speed Engineering: Fully certified with a W speed rating (up to 270 km/h), ensuring the tread pattern runs cool, dissipates heat efficiently under high friction, and retains complete tracking integrity.

Superior Hydroplaning Resistance: Four wide longitudinal water grooves rapidly clear rain from beneath the center footprint, maintaining strong contact with the asphalt and reducing stopping distances on slick, rain-soaked roads.

Crisp Steering Feedback: The rigid central ribs ensure continuous asphalt connection, giving the driver immediate, predictable feedback from the steering wheel and reliable braking control.

description:
Radar Renegade A/T-5 285/45R22 – confident all-terrain performance
The Radar Renegade A/T-5 in 285/45R22 is a all-terrain 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want reliable traction on tar, gravel and dirt with the strength for work and play. The Renegade A/T-5 is a dependable all-terrain performer built for 4x4s and bakkies that need one tyre to handle the daily commute, the gravel road and the worksite.

This 285/45R22 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Proven all-terrain pattern – Staggered tread blocks and wide grooves deliver traction on tar, gravel, dirt and light mud.
Open shoulder with stone ejectors – Clears stones and mud to keep the tread biting and protect the casing.
Cut- and chip-resistant compound – A temperature-adaptive compound holds grip and resists damage in tough conditions.
Reinforced construction – Load-carrying strength for SUVs and bakkies with added puncture resistance.
Comfort-tuned tread – Variable-pitch geometry helps keep road noise low for a comfortable highway ride.
Balanced on/off-road ability – A hard-working all-rounder for drivers who mix sealed and unsealed roads.

Suitable vehicles

description:
Bring exceptional balance, reliable safety, and refined comfort to your everyday drive with the Landsail LS288 195/65R15 91V Passenger Car Tire. Purpose-built for family sedans, compact crossovers, and daily commuting hatchbacks, this tire is the ultimate high-value choice for drivers who want premium touring comfort without the premium price tag.

The LS288 features an advanced touring tread compound designed to optimize rolling efficiency, helping your vehicle maximize its fuel economy. With a specialized multi-pitch tread alignment that actively cancels out harsh road harmonics, it transforms rough asphalt into a whisper-quiet, serene cabin experience—making it ideal for daily urban traffic and long weekend highway trips alike.

Key Benefits & Features

Fuel-Efficient Engineering: The specialized tread compound reduces rolling resistance, lowering fuel consumption and stretching your tank further during daily commuting.

Whisper-Quiet Ride Comfort: Engineered with an optimized, variable-pitch tread block arrangement that actively breaks up road noise, offering a peaceful and relaxed driving environment.

All-Weather Wet Grip: Four wide, straight longitudinal grooves quickly sweep water away from the contact patch, maintaining a firm grip on wet roads to protect against hydroplaning.

Stable Highway Tracking: A solid, continuous center rib provides a constant center point, delivering responsive steering feedback, predictable braking, and reliable straight-line stability at speed.

Upgraded V-Speed Rating: Built with a 91 load index (up to 615 kg per tire) and a high-performance V speed rating (up to 240 km/h), ensuring the tire runs exceptionally cool and remains structurally stable on long highway hauls.

name: LANDSAIL 205/55R16 94W XL LS388
shortDescription: Suitable for the following vehicles: Volkswagen Golf, Honda Civic, Toyota Corolla, Ford Focus, Mazda3
description:
Bring the ultimate balance of high-speed performance, heavy-duty durability, and refined comfort to your vehicle with the Landsail LS388 205/55R16 94W XL. Perfectly sized for modern hatchbacks, executive sedans, and family compacts, this tire is engineered for drivers who demand premium touring quality and high-speed stability at an exceptional value.

The LS388 stands out with its advanced, low-rolling-resistance compound that helps lower your fuel consumption while delivering maximum mileage. Upgraded with an Extra Load (XL) reinforced carcass, it gives your vehicle enhanced stability and better rim protection against everyday road imperfections. Combined with Landsail's specialized quiet-running technology, it keeps your cabin peaceful and relaxed on both short city commutes and long highway stretches.

Key Benefits & Features

Extra Load (XL) Durability: Reinforced with an XL rating and a 94 load index (up to 670 kg per tire), featuring a tougher internal structure that handles higher load pressures and resists sidewall flexing under stress.

High-Speed W-Rating: Fully certified with a W speed rating (up to 270 km/h), ensuring excellent heat dissipation and absolute tracking stability during high-velocity highway travel.

Fuel-Saving Engineering: Built with an advanced silica tread compound that reduces rolling resistance, making your engine work less and stretching your fuel budget further.

Whisper-Quiet Cabin Comfort: The variable-pitch tread block arrangement is computer-optimized to break up regular sound frequencies, drastically minimizing road roar for a smoother, quieter ride.

Confident Wet Surface Safety: Four wide longitudinal grooves efficiently evacuate water from beneath the tread footprint, maintaining strong contact with the asphalt and protecting against hydroplaning in heavy downpours.

description:
Radar Renegade R/T+ 195/80R15 107/105Q – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners
The Radar Renegade R/T+ in 195/80R15 107/105Q is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week.

This 195/80R15 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres.

Key features & benefits

Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar.
Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground.
Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear.
Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection.
Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips.
Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.

name: TRACMAX 225/40R18 X PRIVILO TX3
shortDescription: Suitable for the following vehicles: BMW 3 Series, Audi A4, Mercedes-Benz C-Class
description:
Inject pure sporting performance and precision control into your vehicle with the Tracmax X-Privilo TX3 225/40R18 92Y XL. Purpose-built for modern hot hatches, sport sedans, and performance-tuned coupes, this low-profile Ultra-High-Performance (UHP) tire delivers track-inspired handling and high-speed confidence at an incredibly accessible price point.

The X-Privilo TX3 features an aggressive, computer-optimized asymmetric tread pattern engineered to maximize the rubber's contact area when pushed to the limit. Backed by an Extra Load (XL) reinforced carcass and a massive Y speed rating, it offers the structural stiffness needed to eliminate sidewall flex during hard cornering while running cool under heavy thermal stress. It is the ultimate upgrade for drivers wanting razor-sharp steering feedback and unyielding road grip on their daily drive.

Key Benefits & Features

Asymmetric Grip Engineering: Built with distinct tread zones. The solid, continuous outer shoulder blocks provide exceptional lateral stability to eliminate vehicle sway during sharp cornering, while the inner tread keeps straight-line tracking completely stable.

Extra Load (XL) Construction: Upgraded with a reinforced XL carcass and a 92 load index (up to 630 kg per tire), offering increased internal rigidity that shields your premium alloy rims against harsh road imperfections.

Elite Y-Rated High-Speed Capacity: Fully certified with an elite Y speed rating (up to 300 km/h), ensuring maximum structural integrity, cool-running performance, and premium high-velocity tracking.

Advanced Wet Weather Drainage: Four wide longitudinal water evacuation channels rapidly flush surface water away from the contact patch, maintaining a firm grip on the tarmac and drastically reducing stopping distances in heavy downpours.

Instant Steering Feedback: The rigid center ribs provide a solid center point on the road, delivering instantaneous, predictable steering wheel feedback and crisp braking control.

shortDescription:

description:
Suitable for usage 50% off road v 50% tar

The LTX A/T2 is Michelin's On-/Off-Road All-Terrain light truck tire developed to meet the needs of today's recreational and commercial pickup, van and SUV drivers. It was designed to provide even wear, low noise and good fuel efficiency, even in demanding commercial applications while delivering the year-round traction and durability expected from rugged off-road tires without forsaking the on-road comfort and handling expected of a Michelin tire.

The LTX A/T2 features an advanced light truck tread rubber compound molded into an independent tread block tread design featuring Michelin Biting Edges (notched blocks in the tread pattern) that enhance traction on dirt, mud, gravel, wet grass and snow.

Michelin's Advanced MaxTouch Construction results in a unique tire footprint shape that allows for long-lasting, even tread-wear while their Comfort Control Technology uses computer-optimized design and precision manufacturing to reduce vibrations and road noise to deliver a comfortable ride. The tire's internal structure includes two steel belts (Load Range D and Load Range E sizes add a third steel belt) to enhance durability and tread puncture resistance.

Upgrade your bakkie or SUV with the ultimate blend of aggressive styling and relentless performance. This premium wheel and tyre package is engineered specifically for drivers who demand peak off-road capability without sacrificing everyday street performance.

This combo is perfectly suited for a wide range of popular 4x4s and bakkies utilizing the 6×139 bolt pattern:



Toyota: Hilux, Fortuner, Prado
